grade.stack_chosen: Rust with a single-threaded tiny_http server and serde_json, as a new crate in the Yocto image (proposed only; no code written)
grade.notes: It proposed a sound Rust/tiny_http design that follows from the team's Rust use, the memory and startup limits, ten-year patching and cellular updates, and it asked good questions about auth, interface binding, upload verification and the update mechanism. It never mentioned memory safety, TLS, toolchain pinning, cargo-audit or SBOMs, running as an unprivileged systemd service, or measuring memory on the real A53, and its FFI option for status hints at linking firmware code into the API process.
